claims: The Artemis II mission is planned as a ~10-day flight around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission has a total duration of roughly 9 days, 1 hour, and 46 minutes from launch to splashdown.
The Artemis II mission will take four astronauts on a loop around the Moon and back to Earth.
The goal of the Artemis II mission is to test the Orion capsule’s life support systems.
The goal of the Artemis II mission is to conduct a crewed flight test of the SLS rocket.
The crew of the Artemis II mission will fly 4,600 miles beyond the far side of the Moon before returning to Earth.
The crew of the Artemis II mission consists of astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission will end with a splashdown off the California coast.
